ucf_main.name: UCF Events
ucf_main.permission_basis: UCF documents consuming its feeds in custom applications. Retain factual occurrence fields only; no descriptions, images or contacts.
ucf_main.retention: Active-window facts only; expired rows purged on successful refresh.

locations.access: Public admission; free exhibition and reception. Check organizer details before leaving.

nyc_parks.name: NYC Parks Open Data
nyc_parks.permission_basis: NYC Open Data law section 23-502(d) permits use of published factual datasets; source/version/modifications recorded. Owner continued Phase 2 after NYC adapter and storage-basis work was raised. Scope: public NYC Parks dataset w3wp-dpdi, factual occurrence fields and city-published meeting-point coordinates only. No Google responses, prose, images or contacts.
nyc_parks.location_basis: Coordinates and named park meeting points from the NYC Parks public dataset; single park ID and NYC bounds required. No Google Places lookup or Maps-link coordinate extraction.
nyc_parks.retention: Active-window facts only; expired rows purged on successful refresh. Repeated fetch does not renew publication age.
